regressions.cause: Initial candidate scheduler ownership, cancellation and request regression tests before implementation.
Saved actual pre-guard main artifact: synchronous error listener destroy/stop/reset/hide/nested start leaves obsolete start continuation.
Frozen source/main/legacy preserve accepted NaN fallback. Intermediate task03 candidate regressed NaN while fixing explicit zero.

nativeBefore.source: Task03 actual main, Chromium, two cores; extra same-ID requests and unused duplicate DOM. This snapshot did not itself overlap; task02 had separate actual overlap evidence.

typecheck.explanation: No production TS or public declaration changes in task04. Previous complete check covers 366 migrated TS source files and consumers, not the remaining JS.

buildRetry.explanation: Windows UNKNOWN copy error during a browser run; serial retry succeeded and matched already-tested main/legacy bytes. Later numeric fix received another complete normal build and its own final matrices.

decisions: Single pending RAF or async frame, generation and node ownership after awaits/callbacks.
Unique correlated Worker IDs and pending settlement on cancellation/failure/disposal; unchanged actual track algorithm.
Preserve public facade and ordinary repeated start/stop events, timing, pool order, callback receiver and configuration semantics.
Guard recovery reentry using generation and start-attempt identity as well as lifecycle/fault state.
Restore legacy NaN currentTime+0.5 fallback while retaining corrected zero and old positive/negative Infinity behavior.
limitations: JS responsibility separation; full owned TS and root/runtime installed declarations remain task06.
Synthetic long-clock regression is not an hours-long native workload or heap benchmark; package stability acceptance remains task07.
Native recovery fault events and constructor failure use explicit seams; not real CSP/SDK constructor-failure coverage.
ESM built and dist/docs bytes match; ESM is not counted as an additional runtime-tested format.
Settings external DOM/timer/late-send and heatmap issues remain open for task05.
Windows WebKit is not physical Safari. Local fixture video does not establish arbitrary remote content compatibility.
Intermediate 48/60 native matrices passed before later edge-case discoveries; final acceptance is only the five numeric-final archives listed above.
